citation: Baltussen, G., Da, Z., Lammers, S., Martens, M. (2021). Hedging demand and market intraday momentum. Journal of Financial Economics 142(1). doi 10.1016/j.jfineco.2021.04.029
citation_note: The brief calls the paper 'Baltussen, van Bekkum and Da (2021)'; the saved full text names the authors Baltussen, Da, Lammers and Martens (file l.27-28, l.55). Same paper, title and DOI.

study_summary.horizons: 30 min target (last half hour before the close); predictors r_ONFH (prev close to open+30), r_M, r_SLH, r_ROD (prev close to close-30)
study_summary.sample: Dec 1974 to May 2020; 62 futures (17 equity, 16 bond, 21 commodity, 8 currency); Tick Data LLC 1-min
study_summary.in_or_out_of_sample: in-sample regressions plus recursive expanding-window OOS R2 (min 500 obs, Clark-West test); subsamples 1974-1999 and 2000-2020
study_summary.net_of_costs: no (Section 3.5: 'we do not consider transaction costs'); one sentence claims a positive net Sharpe for S&P 500 futures at one tick

items.value: market intraday momentum, equity: positive, significant (pooled, full sample)
items.detail: Baltussen, Da, Lammers, Martens (2021) JFE 142(1), peer-reviewed. 17 developed-market equity index futures. Signal r_ROD = return from previous day's close to 30 min before today's close; target r_LH = last 30 min before the close (horizon 30 min, entry at close-30). Closes are the underlying cash close for equity futures (09:30-16:00 ET for US index futures), volume-spike times for others. In-sample pooled/individual OLS plus a recursive expanding-window out-of-sample R2 (min 500 obs) with a Clark-West test; trading results NOT net of costs. Data: Tick Data LLC one-minute bars. Table 2 Panel A (l.975-978): beta_ROD 4.18*** (t 7.29), R2 2.45%, R2_OOS 2.88%. Table 5 Panel B 2000-2020 (l.1626): beta_ROD 3.98*** (t 6.65), R2 2.34%. Table 6 Panel A: eta(r_ROD) 1/N portfolio SR 1.73, ann. ret 6.86%, success 0.55 (gross). Table B1 Panel A USA group: beta_ROD 5.99*** (t 6.66), R2_OOS 3.09%.

items.value: not net of costs; positive net Sharpe for S&P 500 futures at 1 tick cost (stated, no table)
items.detail: Costs statement, Section 3.5 l.1687-1697. The paper reports no cost-adjusted table; the S&P 500 (ES) one-tick claim is a sentence only. ES is not a candidate in E.32b.
items.quote: Note that we do not consider transaction costs. Given that trading on market intraday momentum requires frequent rebalancing, the strategy as presented might not be exploitable to many investors after accounting for transaction costs. ... exploiting the effect in the S&P 500 futures yields a positive net Sharpe ratio when we assume transaction cost equal to a tick (a cost level faced commonly by advanced investors in the S&P 500 futures market).

items.value: effect reverts over the next days; present in both subsamples
items.detail: Conclusion (l.3191-3197). Sharpe 0.87 to 1.73 across classes (gross).
items.quote: Market intraday momentum is robustly present across markets and over time, reverts over the next days, and is distinct from intraday seasonality effects.
